'''CT-Tertium''' was a barracks built by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the military base [[Ground Base Seven]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during or prior to [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. The barracks housed [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] stationed on the planet to [[Battle of Drongar|fight]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist forces]] for control of the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Bota/Legends|Bota]] which grew there. The barracks was the largest of three garrisons in ground base seven which was built on the edge of the [[Rotfurze Wastes]], an area of blight. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] surgeon [[Jos Vondar]] traveled to CT-Tertium in an attempt to meet [[CT-914]], a clone stationed in the barracks who he had previously spoken too at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] about the grief the soldier felt after the death of his comrade, [[CT-915]]. Vondar wished to apologize to the trooper for assuming that clones could not feel such emotions, but upon reaching CT-Tertium discovered that the trooper had been recently killed in an ambush.<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
CT-Tertium first appeared in [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]], the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]] written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />
